description: Gas per FP19 op across an input ladder: the object (staticcall), the inline library, the same op in FP127Lib on the same value where it fits, and ABDKMathQuad. null = no measurement on that input; reverts counts, per form, the inputs where the form offers the op but reverted or the input is outside its domain or format; a form with neither gas nor reverts does not offer the op. calls says what each Quad cell calls. summary holds min/median/max per form. The internal forms are the library call alone, timed inside the harness's entry point net of its dispatch. typical (where present) is the same over random inputs that take no shortcut.
